subject: Commitment ladder & legal cutover plan for OpsHealth pilot
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia@opshealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@opshealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot MAP + evaluation window / ask for sequencing

Hi Kimberly & Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our procurement/IT intake, attaching our draft mutual action plan and the SOC2 snapshot our security team requested. High level timeline we're targeting: 6 week technical eval, contract signature by end of October, pilot start in mid-November.

Two asks from our side right now:
- Can Redwood confirm which contract we should sign first (MSA vs order form) and whether you support parallel DPA review?
- Finance needs to understand invoicing cadence and whether Redwood requires PO before signature.

Attachments: OpsHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2_snapshot_2026-07.pdf

Tom (cc) will drive the procurement schedule from OpsHealth. Please advise next steps so we can align internal approvers.

Best,
Alicia Moreno
Procurement Lead, OpsHealth

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@opshealth.com>
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-09T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot MAP + evaluation window / ask for sequencing

Alicia — thanks for the MAP and SOC2. Welcome the clarity on timeline. Quick answers and a proposed sequencing: 

1) Canonical sequencing we recommend:
   - Execute MSA first (covers commercial terms)
   - Start parallel DPA review (legal-to-legal) while MSA is in signature cycle
   - Order form (pricing & pilot scope) can be appended and signed last or at the same time as MSA if OpsHealth prefers a single signature step

Rationale: signing the MSA first avoids rework in case there are commercial edits; DPA edits rarely block the pilot start if we have an interim data handling statement in the order form.

2) PO / invoicing: Redwood typically invoices on milestone (50% on pilot kickoff, 50% on pilot completion) and accepts PO-based purchases. If OpsHealth requires net-30 invoice upon signature we can accommodate but need to know so we can update the order form payment terms.

Action items I propose (owners + target dates):
- Redwood legal (Karthik) to accept DPA redlines and provide comment window (3 business days) — owner: karthik_iyer — due: 2026-09-14
- OpsHealth procurement to confirm PO timing and finance constraints — owner: Alicia/Tom — due: 2026-09-10
- Redwood sales (me) to circulate an order form draft with interim data handling clause — owner: kimberly_park — due: 2026-09-11
- Solutions (Neha) to confirm pilot acceptance criteria and staging plan for eval — owner: neha_kapoor — due: 2026-09-13

If that sequencing sounds ok, I'll open a DocuSign envelope for the MSA + order form once we have the PO terms.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Alicia Moreno <alicia@opshealth.com>, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-10T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot MAP + evaluation window / ask for sequencing

Adding legal context here. Key negotiation points I expect from OpsHealth based on the MAP:
- Data residency / processing: OpsHealth may request a tighter clause — we should offer the interim data handling in order form and DPA redlines in parallel.
- Liability cap edits: OpsHealth might request higher caps for pilot. We should pre-authorize up to 2x standard cap for pilot-only with commercial sign-off.
- Security evidence: SOC2 snapshot should be fine; expect a short follow-up questionnaire.

Proposed legal timeline:
- I will review the DPA redline and send comments by 2026-09-14 (3 business days after review window opens)
- If OpsHealth sends substantial DPA edits, we will schedule a 30-min legal-to-legal sync (suggest Sept 15).

Please confirm if Sales wants me to accept any pilot-specific language ahead of the MSA execution (e.g., temporary data handling) — we can insert a limited-duration addendum in the order form.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@opshealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: Alicia Moreno <alicia@opshealth.com>, OpsHealth Finance <finance@opshealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot MAP + evaluation window / ask for sequencing

Kimberly & Karthik — thanks for the clear plan. OpsHealth finance confirmed: they prefer PO before kickoff and standard net-30 on invoice. We can issue the PO as soon as the order form shows pilot scope and payment milestones.

We'll upload the MAP into our internal SOW tracker. For the DPA: our security team will push a couple of tighter processing clauses but those are negotiable. Alicia will push the DPA redlines by end of day 9/12.

One practical ask: can Redwood provide a draft order form with the temporary data handling clause you mentioned? That will let us generate a PO without holding on final DPA language.

Tom Chen
Head of Procurement Operations, OpsHealth
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@opshealth.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@opshealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-13T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot MAP + evaluation window / ask for sequencing — action summary

Great — summarizing next steps so everyone has a single source of truth: 

1) OpsHealth: upload DPA redlines (Alicia) — due: 2026-09-12 — deliverable: DPA_redlines_opshealth.docx
2) Redwood legal: review and respond to DPA redlines (Karthik) — due: 2026-09-14 — if needed schedule legal-to-legal call on 2026-09-15
3) Redwood sales: circulate order form with temporary data handling clause (Kimberly) — due: 2026-09-11 (attached OrderForm_Draft.docx) — will be used by OpsHealth to generate PO
4) OpsHealth finance: confirm PO issuance and payment terms (Tom / finance) — target: net-30; PO to be issued once order form scope is accepted
5) Solutions/Eng: finalize eval acceptance criteria and staging (Neha) — due: 2026-09-13 — deliverable: Eval_Acceptance.md in shared GDrive folder

I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope for MSA + order form once we have confirmation of PO timing — link will be shared in the thread and uploaded to the HubSpot deal (HS-76342).

Attachments: OrderForm_Draft.docx

Thanks all — short windows here but feels achievable if we stick to the dates.

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0182
